component.name: Lantern
component.summary: Browse your photos with big thumbnails

description.p: Lantern is a fast photo browser for Linux. Open a folder and scroll through thousands of photos, including iPhone HEIC files, with thumbnails as large as you like, sorted by the date they were taken. Nothing is indexed and nothing is cached to disk.
When you find the photo you were looking for, move it to the trash, copy it to your Downloads folder, or move and rename it. That is the whole feature list.
